description: Add task completion and deletion animations to UnifiedTaskItem. Checkbox gets a scale bounce on completion, title gets animated strikethrough, and delete triggers a slide-out-left with height collapse. Uses existing useMotion hook for reduced motion support.
steps: 1. Open src/components/task/UnifiedTaskItem.tsx. Import Animated, useSharedValue, useAnimatedStyle, withSpring, withTiming, runOnJS, interpolate from react-native-reanimated. Import useMotion from @/src/hooks/useMotion.

2. Add shared values for checkbox animation: checkboxScale (default 1). Add shared values for strikethrough: strikethroughProgress (0 to 1). Add shared values for delete animation: itemTranslateX (default 0), itemOpacity (default 1), itemHeight (track actual height via onLayout).
3. Create useAnimatedStyle for checkbox scale: transform [{ scale: checkboxScale.value }]. Apply to Pressable wrapping the checkbox icons using Animated.createAnimatedComponent(Pressable).

4. Create useAnimatedStyle for title strikethrough: use textDecorationLine: task.completed ? 'line-through' : 'none' as before, but animate opacity from 1 to 0.6 when completed. The strikethrough line itself can use a decorative View overlay with animated width from 0 to 100% (interpolate strikethroughProgress).
5. Modify onToggle handler: if motion not reduced, animate checkboxScale to 1.2 with withSpring(bouncy), then back to 1. Animate strikethroughProgress to 1 if completing, 0 if uncompleting.

6. Create handleDelete wrapper: animate itemTranslateX to -width (e.g., -300) and itemOpacity to 0 with withTiming(200ms). Use runOnJS to call the actual onDelete after animation completes via the callback parameter of withTiming.
7. Wrap the outer container View with Animated.View and apply itemTranslateX/itemOpacity styles. Add onLayout to measure and store height for proper collapse.
8. Ensure all animations respect motion.reducedMotion — skip animations and execute immediately if reduced motion is enabled.
9. Preserve existing numberOfLines={2} on title Text and existing lineHeight styles to avoid text clipping during animations.
acceptance_criteria: Checkbox scales to 1.2 then back to 1 when toggling task completion
Task title opacity animates to 0.6 when completed
Delete button triggers slide-left animation before removing the item
Animations are skipped when reduced motion is enabled
No visual glitches on iOS, Android, or web
verification: Manual test: Toggle task completion on iOS, Android, web — verify checkbox bounce and title fade
Manual test: Delete a task — verify slide-out animation
Manual test: Enable reduced motion in system settings — verify animations are instant
findings: Implemented task completion animation with checkbox scale bounce (1.2x with bouncy spring, then back to 1 with snappy spring) and title opacity fade (1 to 0.6 on completion). Delete animation slides item left (-300px) with 200ms timing and fades out, using runOnJS to call onDelete after animation completes. All animations respect useMotion().reducedMotion - skipped when user has reduced motion enabled. Preserved existing numberOfLines={2} and lineHeight styles on title. Used Animated.createAnimatedComponent(Pressable) for animated checkbox and Animated.View for container. No hardcoded colors - all from theme tokens.
